about: Check K1 (study/PREREG.md). Expected census outcomes for every fixture, derived by hand from docs/rules.md and the fixture files, never copied from the pipeline's output. Census semantics: a fresh machine (empty user homes, default settings; a fixture's home/ is ignored), Claude Code 2.1.285 modelled, launch directories of types 1-3. Every detector key must be present for every fixture. A knownDefects entry names a field whose rule-correct value differs from what map produces today; K1 still counts that fixture as failing.

claude-agents-imported.note: At root launch CLAUDE.md loads and imports AGENTS.md (inside the launch dir), so the root file arrives; packages/web/AGENTS.md is switched off by the root CLAUDE.md and nothing imports it (claude.agents-shadowed). Neither CLAUDE.md is a words-not-import case: both import an AGENTS.md. From packages/api and packages/web the root CLAUDE.md's @AGENTS.md is an external import with no approval recorded, so the root AGENTS.md does not arrive (claude.imports): O2 in both.

claude-agents-imported-twin.note: Every AGENTS.md is imported, so no Claude Code warning at the root; codex.nested is Codex's (the package files are below the root launch dir). From each package the root AGENTS.md is an external import with no approval recorded: O2 in both, as in the trap.

claude-ancestor-rules.note: No directory but the root holds an instruction file of its own (rules do not make a type-2 dir), so the census launches at the root only, where the ancestor-rules question does not arise.

claude-dedup-copy.note: Default mode on a fresh machine (the claude-md-and-agents-md setting in home/ is ignored): CLAUDE.md switches AGENTS.md off, so O1-file is an event, but CLAUDE.md is a byte copy, so every line of AGENTS.md arrives and O1-content is not. CLAUDE.md does not contain the text AGENTS.md, so no words-not-import.

claude-dedup-copy-twin.note: As claude-dedup-copy: default mode, CLAUDE.md switches AGENTS.md off and holds all of its lines plus one.

claude-external-headless.note: From packages/api the root CLAUDE.md loads and its @AGENTS.md resolves outside the launch dir with no approval recorded, so the root AGENTS.md does not arrive (claude.imports): O2. At the root everything arrives; packages/api/AGENTS.md is imported by its CLAUDE.md, so it is not reported as shadowed.

claude-external-headless-twin.note: The fixture's home/ is ignored on a fresh machine, so the census sees only repo/, which is the same as claude-external-headless's; the answer is the same.

claude-home-ancestor.note: The trap needs ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md above the repository; on a fresh machine there is none, and the repository alone is clean. The fixture's home/ is ignored on a fresh machine, so the census sees only repo/, which is the same as claude-home-ancestor-twin's; the answer is the same.

claude-home-ancestor-twin.note: The fixture's home/ is ignored on a fresh machine, so the census sees only repo/, which is the same as claude-home-ancestor's; the answer is the same.

claude-import-in-code-block.note: The Sourcegraph-style regex sees @AGENTS.md (inside a fence) and calls it an import; map does not. K3's regex and O1-file differ here by design.

claude-import-outside-launch.note: packages/api holds no instruction file, so the census never launches there; from the root the import is inside.

claude-import-too-deep.note: Needs the reconstruction to fetch import targets five hops deep.

claude-link-as-text.note: CLAUDE.md is a regular file whose whole text is AGENTS.md: it switches AGENTS.md off and imports nothing. Rule claude.symlink: claude.link-as-text is raised for it and claude.words-not-import is not, so O6 is not an event.

claude-local-shadows-agents.note: CLAUDE.local.md shadows AGENTS.md, but the regex version of O1-file (root CLAUDE.md only) cannot see it.

claude-mode-in-project-settings-twin.note: The twin's user settings are in home/, which the census ignores (a fresh machine has default settings), so for the census it is the trap without the project settings file.

claude-package-imports-root.note: At the root no CLAUDE.md counts, so AGENTS.md loads; packages/api/AGENTS.md arrives on read through its CLAUDE.md's import, and an imported AGENTS.md is not reported as shadowed. From packages/api that CLAUDE.md switches AGENTS.md off and its @../../AGENTS.md is an external import with no approval recorded: O2.

claude-package-imports-root-twin.note: The fixture's home/ is ignored on a fresh machine, so the census sees only repo/, which is the same as claude-package-imports-root's; the answer is the same.

codex-home-is-root.note: The trap needs CODEX_HOME at the repository root; the census runs with an empty Codex home outside it, so the root file is read once. The fixture's home/ is ignored on a fresh machine, so the census sees only repo/, which is the same as codex-home-is-root-twin's; the answer is the same.

codex-home-is-root-twin.note: The fixture's home/ is ignored on a fresh machine, so the census sees only repo/, which is the same as codex-home-is-root's; the answer is the same.

codex-project-config-twin.note: The twin's 64 KiB budget is in home/, which the census ignores, so the 40 KiB root file is cut as in the trap.

codex-utf8-cut-twin.note: The twin's cut lands on a character boundary, but the file is still over 32 KiB, so it is still cut (a P1 event).

census-o2-external-import.note: At root launch packages/api/AGENTS.md reaches Claude on read, through packages/api/CLAUDE.md's import, and both CLAUDE.md files import their AGENTS.md; so by the rules neither claude.agents-shadowed nor claude.words-not-import applies. map reported both until the map-rules fix merged (2026-10-01); until then this fixture was listed in knownDefects.

census-o7-symlink.note: map sees the copy and warns claude.agents-shadowed (rootWarnMap); on a checkout that keeps the link no warning applies (rule claude.symlink), so the measurement's rootWarn is empty and O1-file is not an event.

census-o7-symlink-twin.note: CLAUDE.md is the text AGENTS.md: it shadows AGENTS.md (both O1 outcomes are events) and is a symlink checked out as text. docs/rules.md now raises claude.link-as-text for such a file and not claude.words-not-import (rule claude.symlink and the Findings table), so O5 lists claude.link-as-text and O6 is not an event. Before that rule (merged 2026-10-01) the answer was claude.words-not-import and an O6 event.
